name: TMOS AI Usage
author: Timothy DeFreest
description: Every AI subscription and API plan on the machine in one bar panel: rate-limit windows with reset times, prepaid balances, and local token history by day and by model. Reads the CLIs' own credentials and transcripts, read-only.

barWidget.description: All subscriptions on one page: 5h/week/month headroom, resets, balances, and tokens by day and model.

schema.label: Call the cache stale after (minutes)
schema.description: How old ~/.local/state/tmos/usage.json may be before the widget says so. The timer refreshes every 5 minutes.

schema.label: Rotate providers every (seconds, 0 = tightest only)
schema.description: How long each provider's name and its tightest window stay on the bar before the next rotates in. 0 pins whichever single window across all providers is lowest.
